source.title: Editor: Template card Use workflow button is hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

When you hover a template card on a collection page, a "Use workflow" button shows up. Its label is written in English directly in the code, so it does not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/workflows/templates/components/TemplateCard.vue#L93

The rest of the card is already translated. For example, the author line uses `template.byAuthor`.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open **Templates** and pick a collection.
3. Hover a template card. The button still says "Use workflow" in English.

### Expected behavior

The button label shows in the selected language.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.45.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.45.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
